blocks.text: Ashtine Olviga and Aubrey Caraan believe Filipinos’ love for karaoke may also be one reason many of them become good singers. In an interview on the sidelines of the grand media launch of VivaOke, the two performers shared their thoughts on the country’s karaoke culture. “Siguro kaya magagaling kumanta kasi mahilig sa karaoke. Kapag lagi mo ginagawa, mapapractice,” Olviga told Inquirer Entertainment. “Kaya mahilig tayong kumanta kasi masaya kumanta eh.” While Olviga grew up with karaoke, she admitted that she was not particularly confident about singing in front of others when she was younger.
